name: bands
eval: (() => { const t = window.__demo.trees; const seen = new Set(); for (const m of t.children) { if (!m.isInstancedMesh) continue; const a = m.instanceMatrix.array; for (let i = 0; i < m.count; i++) seen.add(Math.round(a[i*16+12])+','+Math.round(a[i*16+14])); } const pts = [...seen].map(k=>k.split(',').map(Number)); const bands = [[0,105],[105,160],[160,210],[210,230],[230,280],[280,330],[330,400]]; const out = bands.map(([a,b]) => { const n = pts.filter(([x,z])=>{const d=Math.hypot(x,z-12);return d>=a&&d<b;}).length; const area = Math.PI*(b*b-a*a); return [a+'-'+b, n, +(area/Math.max(n,1)).toFixed(0)]; }); return { total: pts.length, bands: out }; })()
